arguments.title: [ticket-api] Add built-in `task` schema and health check for ticket types missing a schema
arguments.description:
## Problem

Many tickets have `type = "task"`, but no schema is registered for the `task` type. Transitions/close operations fail with `no schema for type 'task'` (see `TicketStore::close`-path in `lifecycle.rs`), and prior sessions worked around it by renaming the type to `tracker-improvement`.

Root cause: `TicketStore::create` only validates a manifest when a schema is known (`if let Some(schema) = self.schema_registry.get(type_id)`), so unknown types are silently accepted, then break later at transition time.

## Scope

1. Add a built-in `task` schema (identical workflow/fields to `tracker-improvement`, dedicated `type_id`), registered in `SchemaRegistry::with_builtins`, `is_builtin_type`, and `schema_for_type`.
2. Add a ticket-api health criterion `unknown_type` that reports (error) any ticket whose `type_id` has no registered schema, so this class of breakage is surfaced by `ticket health` / MCP `health_check` going forward.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC-1: `task` type resolves to a schema; creating and transitioning a `task` ticket succeeds.
- AC-2: `collect_findings` emits an `unknown_type` error finding for tickets whose type has no schema.
- AC-3: Existing ticket-api tests pass.
